notes.title: 2024 New Version is Coming
notes.notes:
First, I apologize for the long delay! The game has been in development for far too long!

From the end of 2022 until now, there have been no announcements about the game's development progress for two years. The reason is that I've been working full-time during this period, mostly developing the game on weekends or holidays. On one hand, the development progress has been very slow, and I felt embarrassed to share updates; on the other hand, too much  OT- work schedule has been so busy that sometimes I wanted to share updates but forgot in the midst of the hustle. Recently, I quit my job and now have more time to develop the game, which has led to the current official version.

This version of the game has learned from the lessons of previous versions and some player suggestions, making significant changes. So, without further ado, let's get straight to the point~

[h2]Official Version Gameplay Introduction[/h2]

[h3]☆ Map Play[/h3]
If you are an old player of our game, you might have some impression of our tile-matching gameplay. The original intention of that gameplay was to reference "Carcassonne" to enhance the game's fun, but the actual effect was not as expected. The tile-matching became very boring and mechanical in the later stages of the game. Therefore, we made some changes to the map this time.

As mentioned at the end of 2022, this map references the gameplay of "Vault of the Void" and is designed as a small map mode where you can only move forward, not backward. You need to plan your route based on your number of [rations] (simply understood as movement points on the map) and eventually reach the boss at the far right to defeat it and move on to the next level. In simple mode, movement points are plentiful, but in higher difficulty modes, they might be scarce.

[h3]☆ Feng Shui & Events[/h3]
In the map gameplay, I've assigned each tile a "Feng Shui" attribute. Different Five Elements "Feng Shui" have different effects, and various map events are randomly scattered across the map. As you move through the map, you can plan your route based on the events you hope to encounter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39870617/0a6b8e06e9529ea95caea2f4f01eb8f6be843f11.jpg[/img]
The map in Feng Shui mode, showing the Five Elements Feng Shui of each tile

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39870617/77b16622173db934e7e68a6f6e46d82554cfb21b.jpg[/img]
The map in event mode, showing different events on each tile

[h3]☆ Weather[/h3]
This version introduces weather changes (as shown in the top right corner of the image above), which change after a certain number of moves. Different weather conditions affect battles in different ways. I won't go into detail here; feel free to explore in the game!

[h3]☆ Ability Checks[/h3]
This map event is inspired by the dice-rolling gameplay of COC. Some events require attribute checks using the Jade Spirit's stats (agility, investigation, martial arts, etc.). Different Jade Spirits have different attributes, and you can improve your Jade Spirit's attributes through enlightenment points during the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39870617/4d812a3a1725ea7d238aed8b95c4c971fbfddf13.jpg[/img]
Character selection screen before the game starts. You can view the six-dimensional attributes of the Jade Spirit

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39870617/35688e9f7cb132398d88b42e9313c8046e594060.jpg[/img]
One of the events in the game. You need to choose a method of handling it based on your needs and strengths

[h3]☆ Five Elements Combat[/h3]
The Five Elements combat has always been a gameplay feature of "Yu Yan." This feature has been retained in this version and optimized. Before the game starts, you can choose to fight with the [Generative Breathing Technique] or [Generative Circulation Technique]; additionally, the cards you play in the same battle can not only [trigger generative effects] but also have the chance to [trigger inhibitive effects]. I hope this change adds more strategic fun to your battles~

[h3]☆ Demon Intentions[/h3]
In this version, you can see the intentions of demons (provided your Jade Spirit has a high enough investigation value). Additionally, some cards have added the [Remove Demon Action] effect, making self-preservation methods in battles more abundant.

By the way, the attributes of the Jade Spirit, such as [martial arts], [agility], [luck], [eloquence], and [charm], also provide different bonuses in battles. I won't spoil it here; feel free to explore and experience it in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39870617/bafeaccf89d91008ff4497bc48c00c4bfdc49680.jpg[/img]

[h3]☆ Story & Demons[/h3]
The story in this version is relatively simple. On one hand, I'm not good at writing story scripts, and on the other hand, I wanted to remove the somewhat melodramatic storyline from the old version. However, the demons in the game each have their own small stories, and their stories are interconnected. I hope these small easter eggs bring you some exploration and unlocking fun~

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39870617/cdc69c887597c629a65b9ae80eedcea3180ab96e.jpg[/img]

[h3]☆ Game Size[/h3]
Some players have told us that the old version with twelve levels became somewhat mechanical in the later stages. I deeply agree with this. Therefore, given our limited development capabilities, this game has been made into three main levels. Each level has its own unique monster pool, card pool, and weather pool, striving to make each level interconnected yet fresh. The overall game size is not large; in simple mode, completing one playthrough takes about 30-60 minutes.

[h3]☆ AI Usage[/h3]
Old players should know that the four Jade Spirits and demons in both the new and old versions of this game were hand-drawn by our (former) studio artist, Mr. Cai P. However, due to budget constraints and my laziness, some (less important) illustrations in the new version were made using AI, mainly various event illustrations and backgrounds.

That's about it for the new version's gameplay.
Welcome everyone to play~!

notes.title: Yuyan·Liguang Major Version Update Announcement
notes.notes:
One month after the launch, we have received feedback from many players and friends. There are some feedbacks that we think are very meaningful, but we need to spend more time making adjustments to the basic framework. For this reason, we have been non-stop over the past few months, re-adjusted the core gameplay of the game, and made a new trial version of the new mode.

Considering that some players and friends may want to continue to experience the old version, we have kept all the gameplay of the old version while providing an entrance to the new mode in the lower right corner of the start interface. Click the button with the [mountain and lake] pattern in the lower right corner to enter the new mode.

The current new mode only opens some levels and roles. I hope you all have a pleasant experience, and I hope everyone can tell us your feelings and suggestions about the new mode of gameplay. We will continue to develop and improve the rest of the game based on your feedback. You can give us feedback in the discussion area or join the QQ group.

Version: v.0.7.6
New mode description:
1. The new mode redesigned the map walking gameplay, the new map gameplay is closer to the free walking mode; instead of using the brick-laying method that tends to make everyone tired.
2. The new mode adds a new medicine system. The medicine can be used at the right time to make the game easier.
3. The decoration system is replaced with the antiquities system in the new mode. Antiquities cannot be removed, but there is no longer a wearing limit.
4. The new battle mode adds group monsters and group attack cards to attack group monsters.
5. The new mode adds the five elements attribute to the enemy, and adds the [Five Elements Correspondence] system to the enemy's attack.
6. Since the setting of "lower attribute cards to attack upper attribute markers has special effects" is relatively tasteless in the later stage, and the effect is relatively complicated, and it is not easy for new players to remember, so the new mode cancels this setting; but " The setting of "drawing two cards of the same attribute to automatically draw a lower attribute card" has not been cancelled.
7. The new mode discard pile and draw pile can be viewed in battle.
8. The new mode no longer has manual archive function, only automatic archive (only one archive)
9. The new mode has replaced all events and updated the plot (the follow-up plot is still being optimized, please forgive me)

notes.title: 后续开发公告
notes.notes:
《玉言·离光》已经上线一个月了！
承蒙各位错爱，开发组收到了许多建议和意见。经过我们开发组内部讨论，我们将对现有的游戏玩法和系统进行一些更新与调整。但这部分的开发对于我们小团队来说工作量并不简单，这可能需要数月的时间！
在这段开发的过程中，为了保证游戏的新鲜感。我们会不定期实装新卡牌到游戏中，欢迎多来尝试新的组卡套路！

祝各位牌运昌隆！

The new feature has been tested within the team for a few days and there should be no problems. If you still find a problem during the game, or have suggestions or questions about it, welcome to join our QQ group and report to us in time.

notes.title: 8月8日更新公告

这两天我们一直在收集，整理玩家反馈的问题，我们也根据这些反馈情况，一直在开会和优化中。对于比较耗时的优化，我们在一点点推进，对于能立马修复和优化的问题，我们是直接进行优化了。再次感谢大家的反馈。让我们能更好的完善《玉言·离光》

notes.title: 《玉言·离光》8月6日15:00正式发售！首周售价27，与我们携手共赴冒险！
notes.notes:
国产卡牌独立游戏《玉言·离光》于今日正式发售啦！
作为DawnLight Workshop研发的第一个作品，《玉言·离光》承载了四位独立开发者所有的情怀与热爱。同样，《玉言·离光》作为MedusasGame第一个发行的卡牌作品，我们也对它充满了无限期许，开启了首周优惠，价格为27元，希望大家能够喜爱这款蕴含东方元素的硬核卡牌游戏。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39870617/c26ee051efe7acea302efb48da37c353a91589c0.png[/img]
游戏介绍」
《玉言·离光》作为卡牌游戏，融合了策略、探索、轻度Roguelike等元素。卡牌战斗没有职业限制，组卡自由度高，你可以利用五种属性卡牌之间的相互反应，构筑属于自己专属卡组。四大玉灵将在游戏中辅助你探索地图，解决随机遭遇的事件，寻找离光父亲失踪的真相、揭开十二祭祀间背后的谜团。
「玩法说明」
玩家会拥有金木水火土五种属性的卡牌，对邪灵使用时，会将伤害卡牌的属性附加给邪灵，再次使用相邻属性的卡牌攻击，会触发特殊效果。
而且每打出两张相同属性的卡牌，就可以获得一张相生属性的牌，需要注意的是如果抽牌堆没有相生属性的卡牌，则此效果无法生效。合理利用游戏中玉灵的两个属性，构筑适合的卡组，这也是战斗获胜的关键！
更多的玩法和卡牌组合还是需要大家在游戏中自行摸索。另外再透漏一个秘密，游戏的结局为多结局形式，如何选择就看你们的了！
